<h2 id="positioning"><ins><nowiki>Positioning</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/C2MBKJpjDW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Enter instance and stand on the west tile against the Soul Obelisk.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1" alt="keytothecrossing" title="keytothecrossing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to start the encounter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="specifically-for"><nowiki>Specifically for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1" alt="keytothecrossing" title="keytothecrossing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Magister spawns adjacent to you, take </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1 step</nowiki></strong><nowiki> north.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After the kill use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> again. Repeat (See video for example).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: the 3x3 area on the map shows the possible spawn tiles for the Magister.</nowiki></em></p>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Boosting your maximum lifepoints (bonfire </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1" alt="firemaking" title="firemaking" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and thermal pool </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1" alt="thermalflask" title="thermalflask" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) is recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Totem of Vitality </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1" alt="vitalitytotem" title="vitalitytotem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is recommended over bonfire.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Double Escape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894443778115.png?v=1" alt="escapecodex" title="escapecodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used to prevent </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> bouncing to the obelisk as follows:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to obelisk → Activate with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1" alt="keytothecrossing" title="keytothecrossing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> back + throw </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: the first few kills will be slower due to Corruption still stacking up.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
